TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: A user task created manually or automatically extracted by Gemini AI from an uploaded file or captured photo, with optional smart Telegram reminders.

title.description: Short actionable task title (1 to 200 characters).

description.description: Optional detailed task description or notes (up to 2000 characters).

sourceName.description: Optional filename or capture source label (up to 200 characters).

completed.description: Whether the task has been completed.

dueAtMillis.description: Optional due date/time in epoch milliseconds (0 if no deadline).

reminderMinutesBefore.description: Lead time in minutes before dueAtMillis to trigger the smart Telegram reminder (0 to 10080).

reminderEnabled.description: Whether smart Telegram reminder is enabled for this task.

telegramNotified.description: Whether a Telegram reminder has already been sent for this task.

smartReminderText.description: Optional AI-crafted motivational reminder message for Telegram (up to 500 characters).

AiScanRecord.title: AiScanRecord
AiScanRecord.description: Audit log of AI file or photo analysis sessions performed by the user.

sourceType.description: Whether the AI analyzed an uploaded file or captured photo.

sourceName.description: Filename or photo label (1 to 200 characters).

summary.description: AI-generated brief summary of the analyzed document or image (1 to 1000 characters).

extractedCount.description: Number of tasks extracted from the source (0 to 50).

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-owned task items synced in real time.

/users/{userId}/ai_scans/{scanId}.description: User-owned history of AI file and photo scans.
